newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels hold steady.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Thursday with moderate enquiries, traders said.

Sentiment was supported by recent buying interest in the cargo market. "The cargo market may not jump significantly but it's not likely to fall, so suppliers are just maintaining their levels," said one trader.
The 380-cst grade was offered at around $101 per tonne and the 180-cst was at around $105, similiar to Wednesday's levels.
MDO and gas oil were steady around $162 and $170 per tonne respectively.
